description:
My fiancé just broke off our engagement, but I’m done crying over pathetic guys. I don’t need a man to lead me to victory—I’ll find my happy ending on my own! I’ve been trapped in a fantasy dating sim for three years and still haven’t reached a good ending. After all, it’s hard to win when I’m Serdel Loeveste, a forgettable side character. In this next playthrough, I’ll have to take more risks instead of simply doing what I’m told. Will I finally be able to escape the game this time?

(Source: Tapas)
